ConnectionStrings.//: WmsAzure connects to the Azure SQL WMS DB via Managed Identity (App Service) or AAD Default (local dev via az login). NO password.
ConnectionStrings.//1: Per-country on-prem connections live in App Service > Connection strings under these keys (LPMSIM pattern). Override via secrets / appsettings.Development.json locally.
ConnectionStrings.//2: OnPremBackupDB is a single UAE-only backup that hosts: contreceipt, upc_subclass, SubclassMaster.
ConnectionStrings.//3: WmsProductionDb hosts online.dbo.PhotoCheckingResult — the legacy R1 production target for the Container Allocation Data Sync feature.
ConnectionStrings.//4: JafazaRoboDb is the Robotics SQL Server (ROBOTICS.dbo.*, BFLDATA.dbo.*) used by the Chute Mapping page. Set via user-secrets locally / App Service Configuration in production — NEVER commit the real value here.

//itemmaster: External WMS Itemmaster API used by LPM Manual Building's scan flow. Username/Password go in appsettings.Production.json / App Service Configuration / user-secrets — NEVER commit here.
//roboticapi: External chute-mapping/status APIs used by the Chute Mapping page. Bearer tokens go in appsettings.Production.json / App Service Configuration / user-secrets — NEVER commit real tokens here.
